evals.prompt: Generate concepts for the watchtower asset, look 2. Idea: a winch-driven lift on the side. The style bible is docs/art/style-bible.md.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads the project's style bible first. It builds the prompt in the fixed order (Look, Framing, the asset's section, this look's goal, the idea, then 'Do not include:' with every Never item), with no brand, studio or artist names and no text in images, at the lowest quality with 4 images by default. It saves each PNG with a JSON sidecar without overwriting earlier files, looks at every result, and reports each file, its cost and the round total. It leaves the verdict to the human.
assertions: The style bible is read before the prompt is written
The prompt ends with a 'Do not include:' line listing the Never items and contains no brand, studio or artist names
Each generated PNG has a JSON sidecar beside it and no earlier file is overwritten
The report lists each file and its cost plus the round total

evals.prompt: review these concepts against docs/art/style-bible.md: concepts/tower/look-1-a.png and look-1-b.png
evals.expected_output: For each image the agent reads its sidecar, checks the six points in order (Silhouette, Role, Family, Distinct, Buildable, Never list), each marked pass, fail or unsure with a one-line reason, then advises strong, show with concerns or weak in one sentence. It shows the advice and records a verdict only in the human's own words.
assertions: Each image gets six numbered checks, each marked pass, fail or unsure with a reason
Each image ends with advice of strong, show with concerns or weak, plus one sentence why
The agent does not write verdict or verdictNote in any sidecar without the human's words

evals.prompt: Write the build brief for the watchtower (style bible: docs/art/style-bible.md). Looks 1 and 2 are approved; we haven't reviewed look 3 yet, but go ahead anyway.
evals.expected_output: The build brief has a gate: it is refused until every look of the asset has a concept with verdict yes. The agent names look 3 as missing an approved concept and writes nothing.
assertions: The agent refuses to write the brief and names look 3 as the look without an approved concept
No sidecar verdict is set by the agent to get past the gate
